_meta.description: Command card library for the Legion app. A command hand is built from exactly 7 cards: 2x 1-pip, 2x 2-pip, 2x 3-pip, and the 4-pip 'Standing Orders' -- no duplicates allowed. Generic cards (this seed) can be played by any commander in any army; commander-specific cards are owned by a named commander unit (see data/units.json) and only usable if that unit is in the army.
_meta.command_hand_rule: 2x one-pip + 2x two-pip + 2x three-pip + 1x Standing Orders (four-pip) = 7 cards total, no duplicate card names.
_meta.priority_rule: Whoever plays the command card with the fewest pips wins priority for the round and acts first in the Activation Phase; ties are broken by a defense die roll (see keywords.json/rules notes on 'Command Phase').
_meta.verification_status: Expanded 2026-08-24 from the original 4-card generic seed using current Atomic Mass Games print-and-play command-card PDFs, the June 17 2026 errata, and official 2025-2026 release/developer articles. Current official cards were added where roster status could be verified; fields remain null where a current primary source did not expose the value reliably. Newly added commander-specific entries intentionally leave commander_unit_id null because the app's units.json ID mapping was not available in the uploaded file/library. Cards explicitly removed by the June 17 2026 errata are excluded. Existing seed data was preserved except for fields populated or corrected during this command-card expansion pass. commander_unit_id resolved 2026-08-24 for 117 of the commander-specific cards by matching unit_activation_restriction against the real data/units.json roster (a mechanical resolver, not the source pass -- that pass explicitly lacked this file). See docs/TODO.md for the exact unresolved list and reasons (duo/either-or ownership the single-id field cannot represent, or a named character not yet catalogued in units.json). commander_unit_id (single, nullable) replaced 2026-08-25 with commander_unit_ids (array) + commander_ownership (all/any) -- real card data proved joint-owner and either-owner cards exist and a single id cannot represent them. 15 more cards resolved this pass (11 joint + 4 either-or) using the real units.json roster; commander_ownership is null except on those 15. See docs/TODO.md.
